notes.title: The Window 8:Millennium Page is coming now!
notes.content:
Hey! Everyone.For some reasons, I have created a new page (both the cover and the description are more in line with my feelings), and the name is "The Window 8: Millennium". (Millennium really fits my feeling of making this game)

Now you can add it to the wishlist, I will optimize the game during this period to bring a better experience to players.😊😊😊
